survey: A cartoon lasso on a flat purple wavy background, seen roughly face-on from the front or slightly above, with soft contact shadows under the rope. Main parts: (1) On the left, a coil of about five rope turns. The turns fan out to the right and bottom, so the stack's side shows, as if the coil were tilted. The inner hole sits left of centre. (2) A red tie wraps over the top of the coil, with two cut ends sticking up. (3) A tail drops from the bottom front of the coil, crosses in front of the lower turns and runs straight down to a cream end cap, seen from the side. (4) A rope runs from the coil's lower right, rises to a cream honda ring, passes through it and forms (5) the large open loop on the right. The loop is a nearly round ellipse, seen almost face-on. The honda ring's opening lines up with the rope through it. Both the loop and the tail read as lying flat and facing the camera.

errors.where: Left rope coil, compared with the noose loop and tail
errors.what: The coil's turns fan out sideways like a tilted stack, showing its side, yet its outer edge and inner hole are drawn as nearly round circles. A stack tilted enough to show its side would have narrower, oval edges. The noose loop and tail beside it lie flat and face-on, so the coil looks like it was seen from a more sideways angle than the rest of the lasso.

fix: Draw the coiled rope from the same front-facing view as the lasso loop: the turns sit almost directly on top of one another as concentric, nearly circular rings, with only a slight even offset. Alternatively, if the coil is meant to be tilted, draw its outer edge and inner hole as matching narrower ovals, and tilt the big loop to the same angle.
